title: PDF export now matches the full decision card
summary: Exported reports now include ranked top-3 objections, the 'what the panel almost missed' blind spot, and the Contested flag — closing the gap between the in-app view and the PDF.
body: Until now the PDF showed only a single legacy objection, while the app displayed the richer objections-led layout introduced in the Leg-2 update. The export has been brought to parity: it now renders all three ranked objections, the adversarial review's blind-spot finding, and the Contested minority flag. Single-asterisk emphasis (`*like this*`) also renders as bold in the PDF, so the report prose looks as intended.
why: Drafted from a recent product change.

title: Native Windows installer + Apple Silicon support
summary: Príncipe now installs on Windows with a single PowerShell command, and runs natively on Apple Silicon without QEMU emulation.
body: The new `install.ps1` handles Docker Desktop and WSL2 setup automatically — no manual steps. On Apple Silicon, the installer now detects ARM64 and sets the platform flag so images build and run natively. Both installers also drop a desktop icon so you can relaunch the stack without opening a terminal.
why: Drafted from a recent product change.
